identity: Small surveyed junction between GRS II and the GRS III rounded stair tower
referenceUse: Historical exterior photographs and plans are visual references only; not redistributed. BVV LoD2 supplies the connector envelope and DOP20 its roof imagery.
observations: Native rays identify surviving scan fragments on/near the separate 4.28 m² connector; one lies more than 2 m above its surveyed roof.
The architect plan and courtyard photograph show the rounded tower joining GRS II.
The courtyard photograph shows a narrow paved approach to the tower door with planting beside it. BVV orthophoto locates the gap and east-side path, but tree canopy obscures part of the paving.
inferences: Two recessed glazing bands follow the adjoining GRS II facade character. Exact openings, colours and frame dimensions are not measured.
Path centreline, 1.8 m width and low edge dimensions are estimated. The terrain retains its existing survey heights; no interiors or general courtyard infill.
preservation: Retain the complete connector roof. Clip the cleanup margin away from neighbouring footprints, and preserve existing mapped ground materials and terrain.
